name: Warm Sand Mandala
description: Weave threads in warm colours, repeated six ways around the centre.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Weave threads in warm colours, repeated six ways around the centre. Shown on Creative Toy.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Make a picture, or just play with the colours.
howToPlay: Click the canvas, or move with the arrow keys and press Space, to leave a mark.
Pick a colour with the number keys or the round swatches.
Press Undo to take the last mark back, or Clear to start over.
tips: Small moves near the centre make tight flowers; big moves make wide ones.
Your picture stays on this device and cannot be exported.
